title: Algebraization of a completion quotient with torsion conormal
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring, let $I\subset A$ be an ideal, let $B$ be a finite type $A$-algebra, and let $B^\wedge\twoheadrightarrow C$ be a surjective map from the $I$-adic completion of $B$ with kernel $J$. If $I^c(J/J^2)=0$ for some $c\ge0$, then $C$ is isomorphic as an $A$-algebra to the $I$-adic completion of a finite type $A$-algebra. Here $J/J^2$ denotes the quotient $B^\wedge$-module, and annihilation means multiplication by every element of the extended ideal $I^c$ is zero.
